description: This Java class, DeviceListActivity, is part of an Android application that manages Bluetooth device discovery. It presents a UI dialog listing paired and discovered Bluetooth devices, allows scanning for new devices, and returns the selected device's MAC address back to the calling activity.

classes.name: DeviceListActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that manages Bluetooth device discovery, listing paired and newly discovered devices, and returning a selected device's MAC address.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the Bluetooth device lists, buttons, and registers broadcast receivers for Bluetooth discovery events.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up by canceling Bluetooth discovery and unregistering broadcast receivers.

methods.name: doDiscovery
methods.description: Starts Bluetooth device discovery, updating UI to indicate scanning.

methods.name: mDeviceClickListener
methods.description: Handles click events on device list items, retrieves device MAC address, and returns it to the calling activity.
